strings.name: Kim Beom-su
strings.role: Kakao founder and head of the Future Initiative Center
strings.summary: Kim Beom-su, also known as Brian Kim, is a South Korean internet entrepreneur who founded Hangame and later developed Kakao and its KakaoTalk messaging service with teams. His work connects games, communications and platform businesses; products and operations are collective achievements.
strings.coverageNote: Reviewed through November 17, 2026. Current strategy and former board roles are distinct. The SM case is on appeal after a trial acquittal; the prosecution’s request is not a sentence, and the November 20 outcome is not anticipated.
strings.influence.rationale: Founded Kakao, advancing mobile communications, digital content and internet services, with influence on South Korea’s platform economy.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education and early career
strings.facts.f1.value: Bachelor’s and master’s in industrial engineering from Seoul National University; early software development work at Samsung SDS. The 2004 forum biography identifies him as NHN president and CEO.
strings.facts.f2.label: Distinct governance roles
strings.facts.f2.value: Announced departure from Kakao’s board in 2022 and as Corporate Alignment Council co-chair in 2025, retaining the Future Initiative Center role.
strings.highlights.h1.title: From startup team to mobile messaging
strings.highlights.h1.text: Co-founded IWILAB with collaborators; the team moved into mobile services and launched KakaoTalk. Founding strategy does not mean developing every product alone.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Joint philanthropic pledge
strings.highlights.h2.text: Signed the Giving Pledge with his wife Miseon Hyeong, promising over half their wealth during their lifetimes. The commitment is not a completed donation total.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Closing arguments in SM appeal
strings.timeline.t1.text: Prosecutors sought 15 years; Kim denied illegal instructions and sought to preserve his acquittal. November 15 reporting still scheduled a November 20 verdict; no appellate outcome is recorded by the review cutoff.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Trial acquittal in SM case
strings.timeline.t2.text: Seoul Southern District Court acquitted him of stock-manipulation charges. October 28 reporting confirmed a prosecution appeal, so this was not final closure.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Announces exit from Kakao board
strings.timeline.t3.text: Company announces a focus on overseas strategy while retaining his Future Initiative Center role. Announcement and effective office-change dates are distinct.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Signs Giving Pledge letter
strings.timeline.t4.text: With Miseon Hyeong, pledges over half their wealth during their lifetimes for social causes. Planned support for innovators is not recorded as completed work.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Daum–Kakao merger takes effect
strings.timeline.t5.text: Combined web and mobile businesses. May announcement, October 1 effectiveness and October 14 listing of merger-related shares are separate milestones.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Team launches KakaoTalk
strings.timeline.t6.text: Mobile messenger debuts; Android version follows in August and IWILAB becomes Kakao in September.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Founds IWILAB
strings.timeline.t7.text: Starts the business with collaborators that later becomes Kakao. Company formation is distinct from the messaging app’s launch years later.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Founds Hangame Communications
strings.timeline.t8.text: Moves from Samsung SDS software development into gaming entrepreneurship, later joining NHN management. Founding does not date all subsequent service launches to that year.
